questions.def: Parallel increase/decrease requires 'the' before comparatives.
questions.question: ___ more I study, ___ less I seem to know.

questions.def: 'Further' means additional; 'farther' relates to physical distance.
questions.question: Evidence suggests that ___ research is needed.

questions.def: Superlatives and specific topics require 'the'.
questions.question: He is ___ most knowledgeable person I know on ___ topic.

questions.def: 'Unique' acts as a consonant sound; a specific situation needs 'the'.
questions.question: She has ___ unique perspective on ___ situation.

questions.def: 'Economist' starts with a vowel sound, so use 'an'.
questions.question: He is ___ economist by training.

questions.def: 'Classic' starts with a consonant sound; example is countable.
questions.question: This is ___ classic ___ of overestimation.

questions.def: Parallel increase/increase requires 'the' before comparatives.
questions.question: ___ more you give, ___ happier you become.

questions.def: 'Honour' starts with a vowel sound (silent 'h'), so use 'an'.
questions.question: It was ___ honour to meet her.

questions.def: University starts with a consonant sound; countable noun.
questions.question: She attends ___ prestigious ___ in London.

questions.def: 'Expert' starts with a vowel sound; specific field needs 'the'.
questions.question: He is ___ expert in ___ field of linguistics.

questions.def: 'European' starts with a consonant sound.
questions.question: She is ___ European.

questions.def: Profound understanding is a countable concept.
questions.question: He has ___ profound ___ of the subject.

questions.def: Parallel increase/improvement requires 'the' before comparatives.
questions.question: ___ more people are aware, ___ better it is.

questions.def: 'Honourable' starts with a vowel sound (silent 'h'), so use 'an'.
questions.question: She is ___ honourable woman.

questions.def: Superlatives (best) require 'the', not 'a'.
questions.question: He is a best student in the class.

questions.def: 'Hour' starts with a vowel sound (silent 'h'); specific task needs 'the'.
questions.question: It took ___ to complete ___ task.

questions.def: Instruments need 'the'; 'choir' is a countable noun, so use 'a'.
questions.question: He plays ___ guitar and sings in ___ choir.

questions.question: She is ___ only child.

questions.question: She is ___ only child.

questions.def: 'Most' used as very needs 'the' before it, or none.
questions.question: He is a most intelligent person I know.

questions.def: Perfect starts with a consonant sound; countable example.
questions.question: This is ___ perfect ___ of what not to do.

questions.def: 'Member' is countable; specific committee needs 'the'.
questions.question: She is ___ member of ___ committee.

questions.def: 'University' begins with a consonant sound.
questions.question: He is ___ university professor.

questions.def: 'Intuitive' starts with a vowel sound; countable understanding.
questions.question: She had ___ intuitive ___ of the situation.

questions.def: 'Honest' starts with a vowel sound; superlative needs 'the'.

questions.def: Parallel increase requires 'the' before comparatives.
questions.question: ___ more I study, ___ less I seem to know.

questions.def: Specific type requires 'the' before 'kind of person'.
questions.question: He is not ___ kind of person to back down.

questions.def: Referring to specific economic principle necessitates 'The'.
questions.question: ___ of scale often leads to lower prices.

questions.def: "Accepted" begins with a vowel sound, so the article is "an".
questions.question: It's ___ accepted fact that water boils at 100°C.

questions.def: Generic university program needs 'a' (pronunciation matters).
questions.question: He enrolled in ___ university program.
